title: Effect of a nonempty instruction list
statement: Fix a word width $W$, an instruction $i$, a finite instruction list $l$, and an initial memory $m$ assigning a $W$-bit word to each integer address. Applying the list beginning with $i$ to $m$ gives the same memory as first applying $i$ and then applying $l$.
